input: USD/CNY 现汇卖出价 (bank sells USD to you)
note: Published on Bank of China's official 外汇牌价 board as 669.19 CNY per 100 USD. Use this rate, not the mid, because you are the buyer of USD.

input: USD/CNY 现汇买入价 (bank buys USD from you)
note: Published on the same board as 666.38 CNY per 100 USD.

input: Mid rate used to price the spread
note: Arithmetic mean of CI01 and CI02 — a calculation on two published numbers, not an independent market quote.

input: Customer-side spread paid when buying USD
note: (CI01 − CI03) ÷ CI03. This is the genuine 'conversion' cost inside China, and it is the only regulatory-free, market-set charge in the chain. It is a one-day observation, not a constant — see IR-024.

input: Full bid-ask spread on the board
note: (CI01 − CI02) ÷ CI03. Half of this is what a customer pays on one side.

input: Cross-border telegraphic transfer fee
note: Tariff text: 每笔汇款金额的1‰. Applies to 个人 跨境汇款（电汇）.

input: Telegraphic transfer fee — minimum
note: 最低收取50元/笔. Binds only below about USD 7,472, i.e. outside the requested ladder.

input: Telegraphic transfer fee — maximum
note: 最高收取260元/笔. Binds from about USD 38,855 upward, which is why the fee stops growing as the amount grows.

input: Cable / telecom fee, destination outside HK-Macau-Taiwan
note: 另收电讯费…非港澳台地区人民币150元/笔.

input: Cable / telecom fee, HK-Macau-Taiwan destination
note: 港澳台地区人民币80元/笔.

input: Correspondent / intermediary bank deduction
note: The tariff states that overseas bank charges are passed through at actual cost, but no regulator or bank publishes the amount for a given corridor. Left blank.

input: US receiving bank incoming international wire fee
note: The BOC tariff states that overseas bank charges are borne at actual cost, so a deduction exists, but no regulator publishes an amount and it varies by US bank and account tier. Left blank — read your own bank's fee schedule.

input: Annual convenience amount for 境内个人 purchase of FX
note: SAFE states expressly that this is not an annual ceiling on FX purchase or sale; it is the amount that can be handled on an ID document alone.

input: Annual ceiling on overseas ATM cash withdrawal, all cards combined
note: 汇发〔2017〕29号 art. 1. Exceeding it suspends overseas cash withdrawal for the current and the following year (art. 1, second sentence).

input: Daily ceiling on overseas ATM cash withdrawal
unit: CNY equivalent per card per day
note: 汇发〔2017〕29号 art. 4: foreign-currency cards cut from USD 1,000 to RMB 10,000 equivalent; RMB cards unchanged at RMB 10,000.

input: Cash you may carry out without a 携带证
note: 汇发〔2003〕102号: up to and including USD 5,000, customs releases without a permit.

input: Cash ceiling with a 携带证
note: A permit from a designated FX bank is required in this band; in principle more than USD 10,000 may not be carried out, save for the listed special cases approved by SAFE.

input: US currency-reporting threshold (FinCEN Form 105)
note: More than USD 10,000 brought in or sent out must be reported; the threshold applies to the group total, not per traveller. Failure risks seizure and civil or criminal penalties under 31 U.S.C. 5321/5322.

input: PRC individual income tax — comprehensive income
note: Applies to the income that created the balance, not to the act of converting it. Business income (经营所得) is a separate 5%–35% progressive scale.

input: PRC individual income tax — interest, dividends, rent, property transfer
note: Savings-deposit interest has been temporarily exempt since 2008-10-09 (S24).

input: Penalty — 逃汇 (evading FX controls)
note: 外汇管理条例 art. 39, read in full: 处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款.

input: Penalty — 非法套汇 (fraudulent FX purchase)
note: art. 40. Also orders the funds returned (回兑).

input: Penalty — carrying currency in or out in breach
note: art. 42: warning plus a fine of up to 20% of the amount; customs penalties apply where a law or regulation so provides.

input: Penalty — private/parallel FX dealing
note: art. 45: warning, confiscation of the illegal gain, fine of up to 30%; 30%–100% if serious; criminal liability if it constitutes a crime.

input: FBAR willful penalty ceiling
note: 31 CFR 1010.821. The ladder uses 50% of the balance shown in the row as the statutory maximum, which is the ceiling, not a prediction.

input: Onshore/offshore CNY basis (CNH premium) for a personal conversion
note: The earlier source register recorded 1.94% from HKMA Quarterly Bulletin 2012-03 ch. 4. On re-check that chapter discusses HKD rates and Mainland credit, and the figure was not found in the sections read. It is therefore NOT used as a price here: the offshore column is left blank and the page gives the exact cost of each 1.00% of basis instead (see IR-026).

input: Virtual-currency conversion route
note: PBOC and eight other agencies: virtual-currency business activity is illegal financial activity. No lawful CNY->USDT->USD route exists.

input: Notarisation, translation, apostille, courier for the approval routes
note: Art. 8 of PBC [2004] No. 16 requires notarised (and, for a foreign applicant, translated) documents but no authority publishes a price. Left blank; obtain a quote.

input: Emigrant transfer — amount that may be paid in one go
note: PBC [2004] No.16 art. 6. Above this the payout is staged: at most half first, half the remainder after one year, the rest after two years.

input: Emigrant / inheritance transfer — approval-level split
note: Art. 10: at or below RMB 500,000 the local SAFE branch decides; above it, local review then SAFE head office approval. The decision-maker changes with size, not the fee.

input: Documents an emigrant-transfer applicant must file
value: 户籍注销证明 + consular certification
note: Art. 8(4): a police-issued certificate that the mainland household registration was cancelled, plus a certificate of settlement abroad issued or authenticated by a Chinese embassy or consulate. Art. 8(6) adds the tax authority's 税收证明 or 完税凭证.

input: Where the converted money must go
note: Art. 11: the bank must remit directly to the applicant's own account in the country of residence, and may not pay out foreign cash inside China. Remittance is compulsory, so the wire and cable fees cannot be avoided on this route.
